Naveen Patnaik, Congress Demand CEC Resignation Over Manipur Electoral Rolls

Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik and the Manipur Congress have demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the revision of electoral rolls. Patnaik called for a review of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process, a demand echoed by the Manipur Congress. The Manipur Congress also protested the electoral roll revision and sought the CEC's resignation. A Supreme Court plea has also challenged the CEC's decisions regarding the electoral roll revision.
